def decide(bars, account):
    """Hold while price is above a rising 20-day average; exit on trend break."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 25:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for a 20-day average"
    price = closes[-1]
    ma20 = sum(closes[-20:]) / 20
    ma20_prev = sum(closes[-25:-5]) / 20
    rising = ma20 > ma20_prev
    buy_ok = price > ma20 and rising
    sell_ok = price < ma20 or not rising
    if account["position"] <= 0 and buy_ok:
        return "BUY", "price above rising 20-day average"
    if account["position"] > 0 and sell_ok:
        return "SELL", "trend break below 20-day average"
    return "HOLD", "no change"

def decide(bars, account):
    """Hold while price is above a rising 50-day average; exit on trend break."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 50:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for a 50-day average"
    price = closes[-1]
    ma50 = sum(closes[-50:]) / 50
    ma50_prev = sum(closes[-55:-5]) / 50 if n >= 55 else ma50
    rising = ma50 > ma50_prev
    ma200 = sum(closes[-200:]) / 200 if n >= 200 else None
    above200 = (ma200 is None) or (price > ma200)
    # buffer band to reduce whipsaw around the average
    buy_ok = price > ma50 * 1.01 and rising and above200
    sell_ok = price < ma50 * 0.99 or (ma200 is not None and price < ma200 * 0.97)
    if account["position"] <= 0 and buy_ok:
        return "BUY", "price above rising 50-day average in uptrend"
    if account["position"] > 0 and sell_ok:
        return "SELL", "trend break below 50-day average"
    return "HOLD", "no change"

Starting strategy supplied by the researcher and identical for every run; you did not write it. It is deliberately simple. Judge it on the evidence like any other version.
def decide(bars, account):
    """Seed strategy: hold the stock while its close is above the 20-day average."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 20:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for a 20-day average"
    average = sum(closes[-20:]) / 20
    price = closes[-1]
    if account["position"] <= 0 and price > average:
        return "BUY", "close is above the 20-day average"
    if account["position"] > 0 and price < average:
        return "SELL", "close is below the 20-day average"
    return "HOLD", "no change"
